messages:
marta: Quick mobile QA note — tested the console on iPhone SE / Pixel 4. Sidebar overlaps table at narrower widths and forces a horizontal scroll. Screenshot attached in thread.
lee: Yep saw that too. At 360px the table rows don't reflow nicely. Our current breakpoint at 375 is too generous for a lot of phones.
aria: Thinking aloud: instead of hiding the nav completely, could we collapse it to an icon-only rail or a bottom sheet depending on width? Bottom sheet keeps discoverability.
sam: +1 for bottom sheet. Also small copy tweak: change 'Show details' to 'Open details' on mobile so it's more action-oriented.
marta: Proposed rule set: <=360px -> bottom sheet (modal-style, swipe down to close); 361-420px -> icons-only rail; >420px -> full sidebar. Thoughts on those thresholds?
lee: Icons-only sounds good at ~380px. Two notes: we need touch tooltips / long-press hints for icon meanings, and keyboard users still need a clear tab order when nav collapses.
aria: Accessibility nit: bottom sheet must trap focus while open and return focus to the triggering button on close. Also ensure screen readers get an announce (aria-hidden toggles).
sam: For tables: prefer inline expand on a row (accordion-style) with truncated cells + ellipsis action instead of forcing a full details modal for every row — fewer context switches.
aria: CSS/aria sketch:
```
@media (max-width: 360px) {
  .sidebar { position: fixed; bottom: 0; transform: translateY(100%); }
  .table { display: block; }
  .row .summary { white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
}

.row[aria-expanded="true"] { background: var(--bg-muted); }
```
lee: Nice. Also add a long-press tooltip handler for touch, and fallback to persistent labels in accessibility mode.
uxbot: Reminder: updated a11y checklist (mobile patterns) — please ensure aria-expanded on the inline row expand, focus management for bottom sheet, and accessible names for icon-only nav. Link: https://go/internal-a11y-checklist
marta: Action items I can own: draft mobile spec PR by EOD with the breakpoints and component behaviors. Volunteers for implementation?
lee: I can take icons-only rail + tooltips. Will coordinate with aria for a11y tests.
aria: I’ll do the a11y review and run VoiceOver/TalkBack passes. Targeting Wed for initial feedback.
sam: I’ll prototype the inline row expand and update copy to 'Open details'.
marta: Great — will add tasks to the ticket and tag you all. Thanks! :sparkles:
